ENF2 Ref: EC2025/0100 - Address: 48 Hallmead RoadSuttonSM1 1RD - Complaint: Alleged: Without planning permission the conversion of the property from a C3 Dwelling/C4 HMO to a large (Sui-generis) house in multiple occupation of nine (9) residents - Status: PCO

decision_conditions: The proposed change from a Use Class C4 small House of Multiple Occupation (HMO) to a Sui Generis large HMO is not just an intensification of the existing use, but a material change in the character of the use of the property and a loss of a semi-detached single family dwelling which would be unsuitable for conversion to form a large HMO. The proposal requires assessment against relevant planning policies.In the light of the above, it is considered that the proposal would result in development as set out within section 55(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended and planning permission would be required.

The applicant's reliance on the 'de minimis' argument is legally flawed in principle and undermined in this specific case by misleading plans, tenancy agreements and contradictory marketing information, which evidence an intention to create a much larger development.
